turns.user: hey hi sorry im kinda confuesd, i was lookin at returns on cartwheel and saw somethign about a restockign fee?? whats that actully mean and whne does it even apply, i dont want to send somethin back and get charged extra i wasnt expectng
turns.agent:
Totally fair question — no one likes a surprise deduction!

A restocking fee just means the store can deduct up to 15% from your refund to cover checking and repackaging an opened return. It's not an extra charge on your card, it's taken out of what you get back.

It only applies when **all** of these are true (cw-restocking-fees):

* The item has been opened — unopened items are never charged a fee
* The store has opted in to charge it
* The fee is stated on that store's policy page

So before you send something back, just check that store's policy page. If they don't list a restocking fee there, they can't charge you one.
